Titles.jpn: 花右京メイド隊 La Verite

Summaries.eng: After his mother passes away, Taro Hanaukyo is invited to his grandfather's home. There, he meets a beautiful maid named Mariel and finds out that his grandfather has retired to a remote island and has given him ownership of his estate. Taro also discovers that not only is the estate a colossal mansion, it has hundreds of gorgeous maids ready to serve him 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
Summaries.jpn: さえない中学三年生、花右京太郎は母の死を契機に、祖父を頼って上京。そこで太郎が見たものは、向こうが見えないほどの大豪邸と数え切れないほどのメイド。太郎は大財閥花右京家を一代で築きあげた花右京北斎の孫であったのだ。しかし花右京北斎は豪邸にはおらず、いきなり家督を譲られた太郎は、日本を二分する勢力を持つ大財閥、花右京家の当主になるはめになる。そんな太郎が一緒に暮らすこととなったメイド達とは、メイド長のマリエル、警備部・剣コノヱ、技術部・鈴木イクヨ、コンピューターの達人グレースなど、それぞれが特殊技能を持ったスペシャリストメイド集団「花右京メイド隊」。“当主の太郎にお仕えすること！”を唯一の任務とするメイド達に今日も太郎は翻弄される生活をするのですが……

Titles.jpn: 初めまして 御主人様

Summaries.eng: After the death of his mother, Taro Hanaukyo is sent to live with his grandfather, who he has never met.  He soon discovers that his grandfather is gone, and has left the responsibilities of the house to him, and that included the hundreds of gorgeous maids ready to serve him 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

Taro begins to have strong feelings for Mariel.  He also discovers that he has an arranged marriage to, Ryuka, a member of the Jihioh family, his families rivals.  Ryuka later challenges Mariel to a series of events to see who is a better mate for Taro.

Taro says says, "Hello" to Cynthia in the hallway, but to his surprise, not only does she speak to him for the first time, she acts bitterly toward Taro.  He soon learns that Cynthia was a child prodigy, but her gift caused her parents to split up, and she soon created a different Cynthia named, Grace, who holds all the bad memories of Cynthia's childhood.  From time to time Cynthia lets Grace take over and work with the Hanaukyo computer system and other technical advances in the house.

Konoe instucks Yashima to watch over Taro while pretending to be a personal maid to him, to try to get him to be more like a proper, "Head of the Household."  Later, Taro goes shopping [followed by a poorly hidden Konoe] for a gift for Mariel, and later find a lost child, and try to find her mother.

Ikuyo-chan creates a Manga and along with Taro, Mariel and others sell out at Comic Convention while Cosplaying popular Mandy/Anime characters.  Later, Ryuka sets her sights on working at the Hanaukyo house as a maid, under the explanation that she wants work experience.

The annual Budget Softball tournament is upon the Hanaukyo house, with each department playing for the amount of money they will receive for the next year.  Taro, decides he wants to be part of this tournament as well, and soon forms his own team to play, for the fun of the game.
After Grace/Cynthia disappear, Taro and others go looking for her in a hidden tunnel under the mansion.

Taro-soma decides to take a trip alone to where him and his mother use to visit together, much to the dismay of the staff.  At the train station he is picked up by a stranger who he gets a ride from, but it is later discovered she is not a stranger at all...
Taro-soma and Mariel finally go on their first date, but it does not end as Taro expected.  Meanwhile, Cynthia discovers some interesting new about Mariel...

With Mariel still in an coma, Taro-sama soon learns of her origins and her purpose in life, but not before his Grandfather's 'Team' takes her to him.  Soon, Taro-sama decides it is time for him to get her back, even if it means losing the 'Head of the Family' title.
Taro goes to the laboratory of the previous generations' head of the household to get Mariel back; things get out of hand when the security team starts firing
Calm passes through the Hanaukyo household as if nothing happened, but sparks may fly as Taro and Mariel end up having some time alone.
